result:
Solution 3 has the correct final answer, 2. Its 2D argument is hand-wavy and the 3D counterexample is only sketched, so the reasoning is not rigorous. I'm relying on my recollection of the literature on Hausdorff continuity of $r \mapsto B \cap N_r(A)$ for convex sets, not on a complete check. Solution 1 is wrong because the property fails in some dimension, so no answer of infinity is possible. Solution 2 is wrong because it claims a counterexample in the plane, which contradicts the 2D finiteness result.

CHOICE: 3
